Santa Monica World

Walk the real Santa Monica, then teleport to San Francisco, Kyoto, the Getty and Disneyland. Try it before you go.

  • MoveJoystick to go. Drag to look around. Pinch to zoom.WASD to go. Drag to look around. Scroll to zoom.
  • TeleportStep into a 🌀 teleport, or tap Menu → Go somewhere, to zap to another place.
  • Do thingsTapClick the buttons that pop up to talk, shop, ride and play.
  • CoinsEarn coins as you explore. Spend them in the shops.

Continue logs you in and loads your saved player.

Start swimming

Where do you want to swim?

You can swim either to the pool or to the ocean. Your house is hidden somewhere out in the ocean. Practice in the pool first if you like, and switch any time from the Menu.

Nice swimming!

Log in so Santa Monica World can save your coins, XP, gear and map pieces. Then you can keep swimming, and pick up where you left off on any device.
